entry.description: Split `flume-rpc-thrift` into `flume-thrift-client`, `flume-thrift-source` and `flume-thrift-sink`, so Thrift clients only depend on `flume-client`. The classes move to the `org.apache.flume.client.thrift`, `org.apache.flume.source.thrift` and `org.apache.flume.sink.thrift` packages
